segments_b.text: I've been broken I've been burned fell through fire lessons learned every scar a battle cry every tear a reason why
They tried to drown me in the rain, but I rise again and again through the chaos, through the flame. I remember my name.
You can throw me to the dark, but I'll spark a fire in the night. Every wound becomes my mark. I was born to fight.
I'm a survivor, I'm a liar, no change can hold my light inside
I walk through hell and touch the sky and I still rise, I still rise
I'm a survivor, I won't fall, I'll face the storm, I'll take it all
Get on through the thunder, through it all I survive
I've been silent, I've been loud, lost my way
But never bow, they can break my bones
Not my soul, every hit just makes me whole
You can throw me to the dark, but I'll spark a fire
In the night, every wound becomes my mark
No chains can hold my light inside

segments_a.text: I've been burned, fell through fire. Lessons learned. Every scar, a battle cry. Every tear, a reason why.
They try to drown through the chaos, through the flame.
